name: Food and beverages
description: Groceries and drinks. Fast-moving, with spikes on paydays and in December.

name: Personal care
description: Toiletries and hygiene products. Steady demand.

name: Household and cleaning
description: Cleaning and household supplies. Slightly higher in the rainy season.

name: School and office supplies
description: Stationery. Peaks before the school year starts in June.

name: Hardware and construction
description: Tools and building materials. Slow and intermittent; busier in the dry season.
